name: Cumbres de San Bartolomé (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, yellow, white and blue with a broad central yellow stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cumbres de San Bartolomé (a knife and a saint's attributes on blue and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Cumbres de San Bartolomé; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cumbres de San Bartolomé arms — knife and attributes of Saint Bartholomew on blue and yellow
